pages.text: Craft base Witch garments, then use the Spinning Wheel to upgrade them into Alchemist, Besmirched or Green Witch clothing. Sets use a hat or hood, robes and pants; no matching boots are required.

A full Alchemist set clears Poison and Wither periodically and reduces indirect magic damage. A full Green Witch set can improve mature-crop loot and grants regeneration while standing on grass in a forest by day.

The Alchemist Hat needs an Owlet's Wing through Heaven Extract. Owls now supply those wings in survival. Its hood offers another survival alternative. Conjure Leonard or Baphomet and follow $(l:sympathy/demon_pledges)Greater Demon Pledges$() for survival allegiance and its protections. A full Besmirched set now prevents ordinary Feuerwurm prey selection.
